why: Phone-round (phase H) leftovers collected during the desktop round.

items.text: The phone's personZone is never set. The state service's GET /me (services/state-api/src/routes/devices.ts:81-103) sends humanName but no timezone. apps/ui/src/mobile/store.tsx:872-874 therefore sets personZone to null, and setPersonZone never runs with a real zone on the phone. L4i-left-62's mobile half (MobileRoutes redraws on a zone change) has no end-to-end check. Done: /me carries the human's timezone, and the phone's times follow it. A phone-row case changes the zone on the desktop and sees the phone follow; the desktop side needs W8a-left-14's event.
items.still_open_evidence: devices.ts:92-102 returns principal, deviceId, humanId, humanName, kind, scopes, expiresAt, signed and schemaVersion, with no timezone. grep timezone services/state-api/src finds only push/fanout.ts.
